name: Night's Watch actually staggers Physical damage from monsters (#10064)
contract: Night's Watch 807733 reads 'Stagger 25% of Physical damage taken from monsters, distributing it over 5
seconds.' Its EFFECT_1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87) in Spell.dbc, not SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB
(69), even though the C++ Absorb()/Tick()/Pay() stagger logic in AscensionWitchHunterDefenses.cpp was always
written for EFFECT_1 to be a real school-absorb effect that queues the absorbed amount into a 5-slot ring
buffer and pays it back to the Witch Hunter as self-inflicted DOT damage over the next 5 seconds. The engine
only calls OnEffectAbsorb for auras whose effect ApplyAuraName is actually SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB, so the
whole stagger path (including the delayed payback) was dead code; only the DBC's flat, unrelated -1%
MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN ever applied, and no deferred self-damage ever occurred. The fix corrects EFFECT_1's
ApplyAuraName to SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB on load, wiring it into the existing Absorb()/Tick() handlers. A
hostile monster (never player-controlled, since Absorb() excludes IsControlledByPlayer attackers) lands
several Physical melee hits on the Witch Hunter, who then finishes it off; once the striker is dead (no
further external attacker, confirmed by its death and the Witch Hunter leaving combat), health must still
keep dropping on its own for several more seconds from the queued stagger payback alone - something that
cannot happen at all while EFFECT_1 stays dead code, since no debt is ever queued without a real absorb.

steps.label: Room for several monster swings plus the deferred payback
Apply Night's Watch before any hit lands
SETUP: the striker (a monster, never player-controlled) selects the Witch Hunter
Let several monster hits land and queue stagger debt
SETUP: real combat damage occurred while the monster could reach the Witch Hunter
Bring the striker to the brink so the next swing finishes it
SETUP: the Witch Hunter's own swing finishes the striker off
SETUP: the Witch Hunter leaves combat once the only attacker is dead
Health once no external attacker remains
Let the queued stagger debt pay itself back with no monster nearby
DISCRIMINATING: health keeps dropping from the deferred payback with no attacker present
The Witch Hunter survived the exchange
